responsibility: Declares the common data structures and APIs for GCC tree streaming in LTO. It defines the streamer_tree_cache representation, prototypes for reading/writing tree headers, bitfields, bodies, and integer/string constants, cache-manipulation helpers, and machine-mode packing/unpacking utilities used by both tree-streamer-in.cc and tree-streamer-out.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the common tree-streaming data structures and APIs, especially streamer_tree_cache_d, reader/writer entry points, cache helpers, and machine-mode packing/unpacking inlines. Unlike the .cc file, it does not implement cache population, common-node preloading, or streamer consistency checks.
